Indian boxers win 5 gold medals at CWG 2026; one silver

At the Commonwealth Games 2026, Indian female boxers achieved significant success, with five athletes securing gold medals. One boxer, Lovlina Borgohain, reached the final but was defeated by an Australian opponent, earning a silver medal. A total of six Indian women competed in the boxing finals.
